title: Mercury stations retrograde in Pisces
body:
A reply about a trip arrives far later than expected, the itinerary changes for a second time, and we begin filling the silence with guesses. The pressure is to settle the matter quickly, but we make better decisions by pausing, checking what was actually said, and leaving room for revision. Mercury stations retrograde in Pisces as its apparent motion reaches zero before reversing. In this sensitive water sign, we can catch tone, imagery, and feeling faster than facts, which makes intuition vivid and certainty less reliable.

When the same conversation circles back, the repeated wording may expose an assumption that kept us talking past one another. We can restate the agreement, confirm times and routes, save the revised message as a draft, and pause the booking when the details stop making sense halfway through. This is not proof that every plan will fail; some decisions made at the station will stand. After the recheck, we know which part was an impression and which part was confirmed. When the message is mixed, we recheck the facts before making the decision final.
